titulo: Do you know what has happened?
intro: Short phrases to open a story, react, take and give turns, change the subject and close a chat.
p.oye.consejo: It comes from «oír»: «oye» to a friend, «oiga» to a stranger or an older person.
p.contar.consejo: It changes o → ue: «cuento», «cuentas». It means «narrar» and also «numerar».
p.empresa.consejo: It is feminine: «la empresa». You say «trabajar en una empresa».
p.jefe.consejo: For a woman you say «la jefa». The j sounds like a strong h: HE-fe.
p.puesto.consejo: You say «ocupar un puesto». It also means «sitio» or a small market stall.
p.de repente.consejo: It introduces something unexpected. It is written as two words: «de repente».
p.al final.consejo: It tells the outcome of the story. On its own it does not close a conversation.
p.en serio.consejo: With a question tone it shows surprise: «¿en serio?». Without it, it shows firmness.
p.vaya.consejo: Depending on tone it is surprise or sorrow. It comes from «ir», but here it is just an exclamation.
p.por cierto.consejo: It opens a side remark. It usually comes first: «por cierto, ¿has visto…?».
p.interrumpir.consejo: To interrupt politely: «perdona, pero…». It has «rr» in the middle: in-te-rrum-PIR.
p.déjame terminar.consejo: It is a firm request. With «por favor» it sounds softer.
p.sigue.consejo: It is from «seguir» (e → i). «Sigue, sigue» invites the other to carry on.
p.pues nada.consejo: Depending on context, it can close an informal chat before saying goodbye.
b1.texto:
A conversation has small pieces that help you tell, listen and change the subject:

- **Opening a story**: **Oye, tengo que contarte una cosa.** **¿Sabes qué ha pasado?** The other person answers **¿Qué ha pasado?** or **Dime**.
- **Showing you listen**: **¿En serio?** **¿De verdad?** **¡Vaya!** **Ya.** **¡Qué bien!**
- **Moving the story on**: **de repente** (something unexpected), **y entonces**, **al final** (the outcome).
- **Checking**: **¿me entiendes?** On the phone: **¿me oyes?**, **te oigo fatal**, **se ha cortado**.
- **Interrupting and giving the turn**: **Perdona, pero…**, **Un momento…**; **Sigue, sigue**, **Déjame terminar, por favor**.
- **Changing the subject**: **por cierto**, **otra cosa**, **en cuanto a**.
- **Closing**: **en resumen**, **para terminar**; in an informal chat, **bueno, pues nada**, and then **vale, nos vemos**.

Tone changes the meaning: **déjame terminar** can sound firm.
b2.f0.texto: Hey, I have to tell you something.
b2.f2.texto: Suddenly the boss said he is leaving the company.
b2.f4.texto: In the end he said that you are going to take his position.
b2.f5.texto: Sorry, but may I say something?
b2.f8.texto: Well, that is that, I have already told you.
b2.f9.texto: By the way, does everyone know already?
b4.e2.texto: In the end he said that he is coming.
b5.f0.texto: The office corridor smells of freshly made coffee and new paper.
b5.f1.texto: The cold light of the fluorescent tubes falls on the grey carpets.
b5.f2.texto: Behind a glass wall, two colleagues talk in low voices.
b5.f3.texto: A printer hums non-stop in the corner at the back.
b5.f4.texto: Outside, the rain taps the windows with fingers of water.
b5.f5.texto: Tomás leans on the wall with the coffee cup between his hands.
b5.f6.texto: His smile slowly fades on hearing the news.
b5.f7.texto: Lola moves her hands in the air and looks for the right words.
b5.f8.texto: A telephone rings in the distance with a sharp tone.
b5.f9.texto: Little by little, the silence fills with voiceless questions.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! «Por cierto» opens a side remark.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Al final» tells the outcome of a story, it does not open a topic.
b6.o2.refuerzo: That invites the other to continue. It does not change the subject.
b6.pregunta: You want to add a side remark. How do you begin?
b7.frase: Y de ____ se fue la luz.
b7.o1.refuerzo: «Al final» exists, but «de final» is not said.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «De luego» is not said. There is «luego» alone or «desde luego».
b8.frase: Tengo que contarte una cosa muy importante
b8.traduccion: I have to tell you something very important
b9.o0.refuerzo: That is said by someone who wants to keep talking himself.
b9.o1.refuerzo: Well done! You give up the turn and invite him to carry on.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That changes the subject; your friend could not carry on.
b9.pregunta: You want your friend to keep talking. What do you say?
b10.o0.refuerzo: That's it! «En cuanto a» is written without an accent.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Cuánto» with an accent is interrogative. Here nothing is asked.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Cuando» is about time. The expression is «en cuanto a».
b12.o0.refuerzo: It is a reaction of surprise, not a goodbye.
b12.o1.refuerzo: That opens a new topic, so the chat goes on.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Exactly! It usually comes before «vale, nos vemos».
b12.pregunta: Which phrase can close an informal chat?
p.contarte.consejo: The pronoun «te» joins the infinitive «contar». The stress stays on «TAR»: kon-TAR-te.
p.cosa.consejo: It is feminine: «la cosa». “Una cosa” means “something”: «tengo que contarte una cosa».
p.pasado.consejo: Participle of «pasar», used in «ha pasado». With «haber» it never changes: «ha pasado», «han pasado».
p.ocupar.consejo: Regular verb. “Ocupar un puesto” is to take a job or a position. The «c» before u sounds k.
p.ido.consejo: Participle of «ir». “Se ha ido la luz” means the electricity has gone off. The «i» and «d» are short: I-do.
p.viene.consejo: Present of «venir», with e → ie. “Ie” is one syllable and the «v» sounds b: BYE-ne.
p.fluorescentes.consejo: Plural used as a noun: «los fluorescentes». The «uo» is one syllable: flwo-res-THEN-tes, and the «c» sounds “th”.
p.alfombras.consejo: Plural of «la alfombra». The «l» and «f» are separate: al-FOM-bras. It covers the floor, not the wall.
p.zumba.consejo: It imitates a continuous hum, like a bee or a machine. The «z» sounds “th” in Spain: THUM-ba.
p.apoya.consejo: «Apoyarse» means to lean on something; it also means to support someone. The «y» sounds like in “yes”.
p.apaga.consejo: «Apagar» is to turn off a light or a fire. «Apagarse» is to go out: «la sonrisa se apaga».
p.oír.consejo: Irregular verb: «oigo», «oyes». The accent keeps «o-ir» in two syllables. “Al oír” means “on hearing”.
p.justas.consejo: Feminine plural of «justo», agreeing with «las palabras». The «j» sounds like a strong h: HUS-tas.
p.agudo.consejo: It describes high sounds. The opposite is «grave» (deep). It agrees: «un timbre agudo».
p.preguntas.consejo: Plural of «la pregunta». The «gu» before u is a hard g: pre-GUN-tas. “Hacer una pregunta” is to ask.
p.repente.consejo: It is almost only used in «de repente», “suddenly”. The first «r» is strong: rre-PEN-te.
p.cuanto.glosa: as much as (en cuanto a: as for)
p.cuanto.consejo: In «en cuanto a» it has no accent. With an accent, «cuánto» is a question word: «¿cuánto cuesta?».
